name: Elf 3
summary: Elf 3 is BXI Robotics’ bipedal humanoid platform for embodied AI research and development. It uses the company’s own hollow-shaft planetary joint motors and offers an open SDK, ROS2 support and MuJoCo simulation, with teleoperation and autonomous operating modes described by the manufacturer. The platform is quoted by configuration through BXI’s sales team; public delivery volumes and a fixed retail price are not established. The official product page separately labels its embedded Elf 2 video as an older model, so that footage is not treated as Elf 3 evidence.
